Name: Wasteland Weapons
Author: thesandmansleeps
Description:
[size=3]Welcome to fallout weapons![/size]
[size=3]This mod adds 3 melee and 3 ranged weapons from the fallout universe![/size]

[size=3]Melee:[/size]
[size=3]-Super Sledge: a hammer to fix ALL of your problems[/size]
[size=3]-Power Fist: are you brave enough to face down a death claw?[/size]
[size=3]-Shishkebab: mmmmm rotisserie [/size]

[size=3]Ranged:[/size]
[size=3]- Laser rifle: fallout classic 😎[/size]
[size=3]- Plasma rifle: green stuff[/size]
[size=3]-Flamer: slow roast your enemies[/size]

[size=3]Some of the weapons have minor animations which can be toggled off if you hate me.[/size]

[size=3]Weapons will appear on random rotation (1 daily) at the adventure shop for 50,000 Gold and 10 battery packs. 🤑🤑🤑
[/size]
[size=4][b]OR if you have my Arena mod you can buy all of them with the cousin discount at the arena merchant. 😎[/b][/size]
